conviction_note: Q3 revenue very likely lands at or above the top of the $700-750m guide, because Lam (about 35-40% of UCTT revenue historically) grew Sep-quarter revenue 22% q/q and called itself 'supply constrained, not demand constrained'. Against that, Lam guided December only +5% q/q with China domestic down sharply, so the Q4 guide that this stock actually trades on is the swing, and its bar is unsourced. UCTT has fallen after all 5 recorded prints, including a -5.2% on the Q2 beat-and-raise. So the stock answer is a near-coin-flip with a large absolute move: p_up 52 on abs 12.5 gives +0.5. The findings sum to +0.2. The two measurements agree in sign and are both small, because the reaction history vetoes most of the fundamental lean.
bar: Q3 revenue: company guide $700-750m and non-GAAP EPS $0.83-1.03 (8-K 2026-08-03, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001275014/000162828026051853/q22026pressrelease.htm). Revenue consensus about $727.5m (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/UCTT/earnings-forecasts) and $727.6m (therighttrader, https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/uctt), which agree. EPS consensus is disputed: $0.92 (Benzinga) against $0.81 from a single estimate (therighttrader). Q4 revenue and EPS consensus: unsourced, so findings on the guide are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 3,254,534 shares, 7.39% of float, 2.2 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement, down 12.4% from 3,714,027 (MarketBeat, https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/UCTT/short-interest/). That is not a crowded short, and shorts were covering into the drawdown. Baseline 25-delta skew is +0.58 vol points (balanced), put/call OI is 0.61, ATM IV is 101%, and the event-implied move is 12.31%. Run-up is -37.2% over 20 days and -2.1% over 5 days; spot $50.50 is 64.6% below the 52-week high. The Oct 22 leg (-14.9%) followed Lam's supply-constraint commentary. Institutions own about 96%.

findings.finding: Lam Research, UCTT's largest customer (39.5% of UCTT revenue in FY2022; Lam and AMAT together 58.7% in FY2025), reported Sep-quarter 2026 revenue of $8.22bn, up 22% q/q from $6.72bn. Deferred revenue rose to $2.66bn and analysts (BofA) called Lam 'supply constrained, not demand constrained'. UCTT's own Q3 guide implied only about +12% q/q at the $725m midpoint, and consensus sits at about $727.5m. Customer pull of this size points to UCTT revenue at or above the $750m top end (my estimate about $760-780m, roughly +4-7% against the bar). UCTT beat its guide top end in Q2 ($644.9m against $565-605m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat the top end of guidance by about 7% on revenue ($644.9m against $587.7m consensus) and EPS ($0.70 against $0.53), and raised the Q3 guide, yet the stock fell 5.19%. All 5 recorded prints were down (median |move| 5.19%), so this name sells its beats.
findings.why_not_priced: UCTT's Q3 consensus ($727.5m) still sits at the midpoint of a guide set on Aug 3, before Lam printed. If the market were pricing a top-end beat, Q3 estimates would sit above $750m and the stock would not have fallen 15% on the day Lam reported a 22% q/q revenue jump. That sell-off traded Lam's December deceleration, not Lam's September strength.
findings.independence: ASML Q3 2026 (6-K, 2026-10-14) reported EUR 11.7bn of sales and guided Q4 to EUR 14.2-15.2bn, the same demand picture from a different company: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000937966/000162828026065813/pressreleasefinancialresul.htm. It is still a proxy: it is not a UCTT number, and AMAT (UCTT's second customer) has not reported its October quarter.

findings.finding: Lam guided the December 2026 quarter to $8.6bn +/- $0.4bn, only +5% q/q after +22%. It said December would have been 'a little bit higher' without component supply and cleanroom constraints (shipments slip into March) and that China revenue (35% of September) will be 'significantly lower', mainly from domestic Chinese customers. UCTT's Q4 guide, the first guide for that period, tracks Lam/AMAT build plans, so it is likely to show slower sequential growth than Q3. The Q4 consensus could not be sourced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Feb 2025 print (-28.2%) and Apr 2025 print (-13.9%) were both guidance-driven sell-offs on weak WFE and China. The Q2 2026 raised guide still drew -5.2%. Guidance is the line that has produced this name's largest moves.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: UCTT fell 14.86% on Oct 22 on Lam's guide (https://koalagains.com/daily-top-movers/top-losers/details/4e890131-b2ce-452e-ac62-1aea0a1755b1). It is still filed because the transmission to UCTT's own Q4 number is unconfirmed until tonight. If the Lam deceleration were fully priced, the -37% 20-day drawdown would already be the floor, and a sub-consensus Q4 guide would not move the stock. This name's reaction history says such guides do move it.
findings.independence: Stocktwits, 2026-10-22: Needham called it an 'unexpected deceleration' and Morgan Stanley called the December miss 'undoubtedly a negative' (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/lrcx-stock-sinks-as-analysts-trim-targets-see-supply-constraints-but-longer-term-bull-case-remains/cZxwBbwRBww). Counterweight: Lam frames the constraint as supply rather than demand, with 2027 WFE above $200bn, and a supply-constrained OEM can still pull subsystems hard. The size is net of that. Shares Lam's Oct 21 release with finding 1 but reads a different period (December vs September).

findings.finding: Working-capital funding: UCTT filed a $400m at-the-market common stock program on 2026-08-14 (reference price $92.91; about 9% of the market cap then, about 17% at today's $2.4bn), after H1 operating cash flow of -$74.4m on an inventory build from $390.9m to $629.9m. The Q3 release and 10-Q will show how much was sold and whether cash burn continued. Asked what the money buys: capacity in Malaysia, Singapore and Czechia toward a $4bn run rate by mid-2027, corroborated by the inventory build and by Lam saying components are the bottleneck. So it funds a visible ramp. The residual negative is the overhang of unsold ATM capacity at $50.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell about 9% on the day the ATM was filed, 2026-08-14 (TIKR, https://www.tikr.com/blog/ultra-clean-stock-fell-7-in-a-day-as-the-chip-selloff-deepened-heres-where-the-stock-could-go). No prior print has turned on cash flow.
findings.why_not_priced: The amount actually sold under the ATM, and the Q3 cash burn, are not public until the release and 10-Q. If the market had priced a fully used ATM, the share count in consensus EPS would reflect it, and the sources do not show that.
findings.independence: The Q2 8-K balance sheet (inventories $629.9m against $390.9m at year-end 2025): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001275014/000162828026051853/q22026pressrelease.htm. The ATM and the inventory build are one concern, so they are merged here.

outside_window.finding: Ichor (ICHR), the closest subsystem peer, reports Q3 2026 on 2026-11-02 against a $315-345m guide. It is a read-across for the subsystem tier, but it lands after this window.

baseline_tension: The skew is balanced (+0.58), so it states no direction. The -37% 20-day run-up and falling short interest give a washed-out setup that a strong Q3 could relieve. Against that, this name has fallen after 5 of 5 recorded prints, including a beat-and-raise, and Lam's December deceleration is the live negative. The evidence mildly contradicts the run-up but not the skew, so p_up sits only slightly above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; 0/5 prints up, Q2 beat-and-raise sold -5.2%): Q3 revenue-beat finding cut from +2.5 to +1.5; p_up 53 -> 52

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the ATM funds a corroborated capacity ramp (inventory build, Lam supply-constrained), so the ATM -0.75 and the OCF/inventory -0.5 were merged into one financing finding at -0.3 (overhang only)
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): Q3 revenue bar sourced to the guide plus two agreeing estimates; Q4 bar unsourced, so the guidance finding stays capped at -1.0
Lesson 7 (positioning): SI 7.39% of float, 2.2 DTC, falling, so no squeeze adjustment to the negative; skew balanced, so no adjustment
